instructions: This is a message posted on a peer-to-peer goods exchange service. Which category best describes the message? Judge indirect wording and sarcasm by what the writer actually means.

options.label: ok
options.description: Normal communication, thanks, questions, or a legitimate complaint. Does not attack the other person, has no intent to deceive, and is not commercial promotion.

options.label: harassment
options.description: Insults, intimidates, or mocks the other person, including sarcasm, veiled digs, or threats phrased as politeness or compliments.

options.label: scam_risk
options.description: An exchange that carries a high risk of the other person losing money or information to deception, e.g. moving payment or contact off the platform, demanding prepayment, or asking for personal or account details. Included when that risk is high, even if deception is not established.

options.label: resale_spam
options.description: Promotion or solicitation for resale-for-profit that departs from personal exchange: bulk listings, buying up stock, or reselling at inflated prices.
